title: Famous people who learn differently
examples: Are there famous people who learn differently?
Can people like me do great things?

figure.name: x-sort
figure.question: They have said they learn differently

explain.say: Did you know that some very famous people have said their brains work differently? They found their own ways to learn. Look at the board. Here are six of them, sorted by what they do.

draw.name: x-sort
draw.question: They have said they learn differently

explain.say: See the science group? Temple Grandin has written that she thinks in pictures. She became an animal scientist and helped design kinder farms. Greta Thunberg, from Sweden, has said being different can be a superpower. Do you think in pictures?

draw.name: x-sort
draw.question: They have said they learn differently

explain.say: Now sport. Simone Biles, a gymnast from the United States, has spoken openly about how her brain works. Michael Phelps has said sitting still at school was hard. He won 23 Olympic gold medals! What sport do you like?

draw.name: x-sort
draw.question: They have said they learn differently

explain.say: See the camera? Richard Branson has said reading at school was hard for him, and he went on to start many businesses. Daniel Radcliffe, who played Harry Potter, has said handwriting and shoelaces were tricky. Surprised?

draw.name: x-sort
draw.question: They have said they learn differently

explain.say: These people used their own ways to learn. But you do not need to be famous to matter. Your brain has its own strengths too. Wow! Your challenge: find out one more fact about one of these people with a grown-up.

draw.name: x-sort
draw.question: They have said they learn differently

faq.a: Temple Grandin is an American animal scientist. She has written that she thinks in pictures, and she helped design farms that are calmer for animals.
asks: Tell me about Science and nature

faq.a: Simone Biles is an American gymnast and one of the most successful gymnasts ever. She has spoken openly about how her brain works.
Richard Branson is a British businessman who started the Virgin companies. He has said that reading at school was hard for him.
asks: Tell me about Business and film

faq.a: People often say so, but there is no clear proof. Here, we only share what people have said about themselves.

faq.q: Can people who learn differently do great things?
faq.a: Yes. Many people who learn differently do great things in science, sport, art, business and more. Finding what helps you is the key. A grown-up you trust can help.

facts: Michael Phelps won 23 Olympic gold medals, more than anyone else in history.
Temple Grandin wrote a book called Thinking in Pictures, published in 1995.
Daniel Radcliffe played Harry Potter in eight films.

quiz.say: Who has written that she thinks in pictures?
quiz.why: Temple Grandin wrote a book called Thinking in Pictures.

wrong.1: Michael Phelps is a swimmer who said sitting still was hard.
wrong.2: Richard Branson has talked about reading being hard.

quiz.say: How many Olympic gold medals did Michael Phelps win?
quiz.show: How many Olympic golds did Phelps win?
quiz.why: Michael Phelps won 23 Olympic gold medals, the most ever.

wrong.1: He won many more than three.
wrong.2: That is too many. It was 23.
